best_idea: Keep one damage function that applies level reduction, then armour with a percent floor, then a minimum of one, and decide the kill before shields, so every hit goes through one ledger.
decision_why: The damage order is a small pure function that fits one engine and one ledger if it lives in src/fight; we do not take the projectile miss scatter (a visible miss is a state, not a shot), and we do not copy the shield-before-kill order without a test that pins it.
acceptance: A server test asserts that a raw 40 hit into armour 10 with a 25% floor deals 30, a raw 40 hit into armour 35 deals 10, every hit deals at least 1, and the lethal-blow rule with shields is pinned by one test.
